messages:
megan: Heads up — staging image push to EU ECR got quarantined by the publish check. Cosign verify failed with a KMS key mismatch. ccing @nate @oliver

deploy-bot: publish blocked for image: eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime/staging:20260321-abc123
reason: cosign verify FAILED (key id mismatch)
logs:
```
ERROR: verify: signature verification failed
expected key id: rk-2024-us
found key id: cust-01
attestation: present
```

nate: ugh. which step set the wrong key? expected vs found values?

megan: expected key: projects/redwood-kms/keys/release-key-2024 (kid=rk-2024-us). found: projects/customer-kms/keys/legacy (kid=cust-01). image layers look identical, attestation header differs.

oliver: could be the mirror agent that pushed to EU picked up a different COSIGN_KEY env after the config flip. we had that beta mirror change earlier today.

ivy: confirm: canary mirror runs with env from `mirror-agent-config`. I see a recent override `COSIGN_KEY=/secrets/customer-cosign` in the eu canary pool.

megan: decision: HOLD promotion. rollback to pinned digest in staging and do a manual republish signed with the canonical release key (rk-2024-us). @release-manager please hold the EU change window for this release.

nate: pin command for ops runbook: `k8s-image-promote --env=staging --image=eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:deadbeef --pin`

megan: manual republish plan:
1) pull artifact by digest from central registry
2) retag to staging tag referencing pinned digest
3) cosign sign with rk-2024-us KMS key
4) push to eu-ecr and run `deploybot publish` check

deploy-bot: acknowledged. queued manual re-sign job id=job-8791. auto-publish aborted for this image until manual OK. once republish completes update release notes with: "staging republished to EU with correct signing key"

oliver: rollback playbook (if manual republish fails):
- label release `hold`
- route canary traffic down
- rollback deployment to image `@sha256:deadbeef`
- open follow-up for mirror config

megan: I ran the manual sign+push steps and re-triggered publish. cosign verify now passes. logs:
```
VERIFIED: signature for eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:deadbeef
key id: rk-2024-us
status: OK
```

ops-bot: observability: canary-eu CPU/502 spike at 12:34 — monitoring the rollout, may be unrelated.

nate: thanks. I'll update internal release notes and add a note about the mirror's cosign env override. also opening INFRA-456 to fix mirror config so it cannot override COSIGN_KEY for release-tagged pushes.

megan: :thumbsup: leaving INFRA-456 open for follow-up and adding a short postmortem line to the release board.

deploy-bot: publish succeeded: image=eu-ecr.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:deadbeef; event=publish.complete; duration=120s

release-manager: Holding GA until we observe EU for 2h with no regressions. Putting a note on the release board now.
